coverage: exactly one model-authored natural-language description for each of the top 100 P80 skill targets by frozen occurrence rank
purpose: high-volume development stress test for Track 2 semantic fallback; not production prevalence or independent user evidence
ground_truth_policy: target identities are real AF v31 skills, but the authored query-to-target semantic relation is a hypothesis until adjudicated; misses, regressions, surprising hits, and a deterministic sample of nominal hits must be reviewed

evaluation_policy.manual_review: all misses plus deterministic stratified sample of nominal hits
evaluation_policy.no_posthoc_cleaning: raw benchmark score remains unchanged even if later review finds an authored case ambiguous or wrong; adjudication is reported separately

architecture_boundary: frontend-only candidate; production-form G1 uses build-time AF training-language enrichment and deterministic C0-top1+G1d-4slot fusion; no API, embeddings, or model inference
notes: One case per target maximizes breadth rather than paraphrase depth.
Queries intentionally vary between task descriptions, tool descriptions, credential paraphrases, work context, and indirect domain clues.
This suite was authored after the G1 architecture existed, so it is development evidence, not confirmatory validation.
